messages:
riley: morning — follow-up from the 03:15am flood. want to lock owners/times for the remediation items so we don't ship the same noise back to oncall. items proposed:
- bump noisy infra CPU alerts (owner: zoe) target: 72h with 24h staging dry-run
- add dedupe key for error-rate alerts (owner: ben) target: 7d; prefer job-level but see note below
- paging policy change: low -> slack only, med -> oncall daytime only; grandfather 14d (owner: marco) target: 48h
- suppression for flappers -> emit suppressed metric and route to #suppression-review (owner: zoe) target: 14d
Please ack and call out blockers. tagging @ops-bot to create tracker. :wave:

zoe: ack. i can take CPU bump + suppression. plan: bump threshold in staging to 0.92, `for: 2m` stabilization, 24h dry-run, then prod. will paste rule diff and grafana link.

ben: taking dedupe. lean `job + error_signature` as primary dedupe, but add exception: if `user_id` present then include it in key so we don't hide user-impacting regressions. PR by Thu, adding CI smoke to validate.

marco: i'll own paging policy updates. two quick clarifications: 1) define daytime window — 09:00-18:00 PT ok? 2) confirm 14d grandfathering for existing alerts?

riley: answers: daytime 09:00-18:00 PT = good; grandmothering (typo) i mean grandfathering yes 14d. also exclude control-plane hosts from suppression. i'll DM the list.

zoe: rule diff i'll test in staging tomorrow morning:
```
# old
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.85
# proposed
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.92
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: medium
```
will monitor charts and rollback if we see missed capacity.

ben: dedupe template snippet i'll add: `dedupe_key: '{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}{{ "":"" if not user_id else ":" + user_id }}'` (will make syntactically compatible in the templating engine). CI smoke will emit synthetic 5xxs and assert dedupe doesn't swallow unique user errors.

marco: ok i'll update the paging policy doc & rota rules. PR up by EOD tomorrow; will include runbook guidance for suppressed-but-persistent alerts and a rollback plan for the 14d grandfathering window.

ops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-12345 "Alert tuning sprint: cpu bump, dedupe, paging, suppression" assigned to [zoe, ben, marco] due 2026-08-01 :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7d (1915617345).

zoe: small blocker: team capacity next Tue is light (vacation overlap). if PR scheduling needs shifting, i'll flag here, otherwise 72h plan stands.

ben: noted. i can shift CI smoke earlier this week to avoid the gap.

riley: thanks — i'll consolidate into the postmortem action tracker and close the task when the smoke tests and dry-run pass. final checklist: zoe (72h/dry-run), ben (7d + CI smoke), marco (48h + 14d grandfather). flag here if you need more time. :thumbsup:
